raw_response:
Alright, let me think through this year on my land...

---

I've been farming these 10.1 mu for thirty years now. Same pattern every year — wheat then maize, wheat then maize. My son and daughter-in-law go into town for work a lot of the year, so it's mostly me and the wife handling the fields. During wheat harvest and maize planting they come back if they can, but I can't always count on it. Eight mouths to feed means every yuan counts.

**For wheat this autumn:**

I'll plant around the 10th of October, after the maize comes off. I usually get seed from the agri-store in the county — "Jimai 22" is what Old Wang down the road grows and his fields look alright, so I'll do the same. Maybe 15 kg of seed per mu.

Before planting I spread one bag of compound fertilizer — the 15-15-15 kind, that's 40 kg — and I'll add maybe 10 kg of urea as base too. Then at green-up in early March, when I can see if the wheat is yellow or not, I top-dress urea, about 15 kg per mu. If the price of urea goes up like last year I'll cut back a bit. My neighbor uses less than me and his yields are similar, so maybe I'm using too much, but I'd rather not risk it.

Winter water before the ground freezes in late November — one time. Green-up water in March — one time. Jointing water in April — one time. That's three waterings. If the rain comes good in May I skip the grain-fill water, but usually I do it too. The electricity meter runs and it costs real money. I pay maybe 30 yuan per mu each watering.

Herbicide in March, one time, for the broadleaf weeds. If I see aphids at heading, one insecticide spray. For harvest I hire the combine that comes through the village, 50 yuan per mu.

I figure about 400 kg of wheat per mu in a normal year. Good year maybe 450, bad year 350.

**For maize after wheat:**

The day after wheat harvest — mid-June — I need to get the maize in the ground. No time to plow. I hire the no-till planter that comes through, "Zhengdan 958" hybrid seed, one bag per mu costs about 80 yuan. The planter drops seed and base fertilizer together, one pass. That's 30 yuan per mu for the planter service.

Base is compound fertilizer at planting, 40 kg per mu. At big trumpet stage, around late July, I top-dress about 20 kg of urea per mu. If it's been dry I'll pump water once then. Usually the rainy season gives enough water in July-August. Maybe one irrigation if there's a dry spell.

Herbicide right after planting, before the weeds come up. If armyworm shows up I spray once. Harvest end of September with a combine, 60 yuan per mu.

Maize I expect around 450 kg per mu. Better than wheat usually.

I don't have a lot of cash sitting around so I buy fertilizer when I have money from selling the previous crop. Sometimes I buy on account at the agri-store and pay after harvest. That's how most of us do it.
